articles.headline: 'AI Equals Memory': Why The AI Boom Now Runs Through Micron, SK Hynix And Samsung

articles._summary: The defining bottleneck of the artificial-intelligence boom is no longer the graphics processor. It is the memory that sits next to it. That is the core argument of a Monday note from Jordi Visser, head of AI macro nexus at 22V Research.

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: 4 Gold ETFs That Could Regain Momentum As Goldman Sachs Sees $900 Upside For 2026
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs says gold's rally isn't over despite recent weakness. Here's why gold ETFs could regain momentum as the gold price forecast remains bullish.
articles._summary: Gold prices have stumbled over the past four months, but Goldman Sachs believes the pullback is unlikely to mark the end of the precious metal’s rally, a view that could reignite interest in gold-backed ETFs if the investment bank’s forecast plays out. The firm argues that both structural and cyclical drivers remain intact, even as the potential for higher interest rates has temporarily weighed on investor demand for gold and gold-backed ETFs.
articles._zh_headline: 高盛预计 2026 年 4 只黄金 ETF 有望重获 900 美元的上涨空间
articles._zh_summary: 过去四个月金价大幅下跌，但高盛认为，此次回调不太可能标志着贵金属涨势的结束，如果该投行的预测成真，这一观点可能会重新激发人们对黄金支持的 ETF 的兴趣。该公司认为，尽管利率上升的可能性暂时影响了投资者对黄金和黄金支持的 ETF 的需求，但结构性和周期性驱动因素仍然完好无损。
